summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — Adds a `timeError` member to `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface, alongside the existing `eDep`/`eDepError` pair. The schema version is bumped and the previous schema is kept as `old_schemas/edm4hep_v6.yaml`. Downstream code and files are affected, and this field is what 4D tracking needs to replace its current per-sensor resolution placeholders.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#55](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/55)** — Calorimeter hit creation for Pandora now goes through the new `LCCaloHit` factory, so hits can be customised without changes to PandoraSDK. Requires LCContent#45.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#45](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/45)** — Introduces `LCCaloHit`, a local extension point for calorimeter hits that avoids modifying PandoraSDK's `CaloHit`. It also supports the new FieldMap-based SDK persistency. CLD ttbar reconstruction was checked and gives unchanged results.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/72)** — Adds optional 4D (time-aware) tracking to `CKFTrackingAlg`. Hit time can be used as an extra CKF measurement, and a doublet time cut is available in seeding. Per-sensor time resolutions are configurable and serve as a placeholder until the EDM4hep per-hit `timeError` is used.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#71](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/71)** — Adds BIBUtils, Gaudi-native ports of the beam-induced-background cleaning processors with tests and example steering. Two are renamed: `FilterConeHits` becomes `TrackerHitHelixFilter` and `CaloConer` becomes `CaloHitConeFilter`. The ROOT Hist component is now required, and this completes the move away from the k4Reco fork.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — Adds an option to run conformal tracking on silicon hits in the ALLEGRO digi+reco sequence and enables it in the o1_v03 and o2_v01 tests. It relies on k4Reco#72, and optionally on cylindrical ECAL surface plugins in k4geo, to extrapolate tracks to the calorimeter.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/72)** — ConformalTracking gains configurable ECAL barrel and endcap face system IDs. The defaults stay at 20/29 for ILD/CLD, and ALLEGRO uses 4/5. Electromagnetic calorimeters are now also identified by their type flags. Tracks are kept instead of failing the fit when no calorimeter-face state is found.

- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#490](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/490)** — Fixes Marlin random seeds not being refreshed per event. New-event detection compared `LCEvent` pointers, and a new event is often allocated at the same address as the previous one, so many events silently reused the same seeds. A regression test is added.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#64](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/64)** — `GaussSmearVertex` and `FlatSmearVertex` now shift the whole event position. Previously beam particles from the HepMC3 root vertex stayed at (0,0,0) while all other vertices were smeared.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1691](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1691)** — `HepMC3EventReader` now applies the event length unit to the primary vertex position. Previously, vertex positions were wrong for HepMC3 files stored in centimetres.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/109)** — Fixes `TracksFromGenParticles`, which with `ExtrapolateToECal=False` could read uninitialised ECAL geometry and attach garbage calorimeter track states. Extrapolation now only runs when requested, geometry lookup failures return a failure status instead of throwing, and cellIDs are no longer truncated to 32 bits.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1678)** — `Geant4EventAction` now throws if shared actions are used in single-threaded mode, which previously could silently write events twice. The DDSim `OutputConfig` user-plugin example is fixed for multi-threaded running, and steering files such as IDEA's should be updated accordingly.
